outcome: Use of domperidone as a galactagogue
cohort: 21,914 women who delivered live-born singletons at the Women's and Children's Hospital (WCH), Adelaide, between January 2004 and December 2008
finding: Increasing maternal age, maternal obesity, primiparity, cesarean delivery, preterm birth, neonatal hospitalization, increasing socioeconomic status, and later year of delivery were associated with an increased likelihood of domperidone use.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased likelihood of domperidone use.
